title: Apple Intelligence approved for launch in China with Alibaba's Qwen AI
description: China's Cyberspace Administration approved Apple's AI services for the domestic market, clearing the way for Apple Intelligence features across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS. The approval rests on a partnership integrating Alibaba's Qwen model into Apple Intelligence for Chinese users, since Apple cannot rely on its US-trained models there, though no launch timeframe has been given.

title: Anthropic and Blackstone launch Ode, a $1.5 billion AI implementation venture
description: Anthropic and Blackstone launched Ode, a $1.5 billion venture that embeds engineers directly inside enterprise clients to help them deploy AI into core business operations. The move reflects a broader shift among frontier labs toward viewing AI implementation, not just model-building, as the next major commercial opportunity.

title: Amid hardware legal battle, OpenAI releases a $230 keyboard for Codex
description: OpenAI launched the Codex Micro, a $230 keyboard co-designed with Work Louder for managing fleets of AI coding agents, featuring light-up "Agent Keys" showing agent status, programmable shortcut keys, a joystick for launching workflows, and a dial to adjust reasoning effort. The release comes as OpenAI faces a trade-secret lawsuit from Apple over its hardware plans.

title: Thinking Machines unveils Inkling, its first open-weight model, betting against one-size-fits-all AI
description: Thinking Machines Lab, founded by former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati, released Inkling, a 975-billion-parameter open-weight mixture-of-experts model trained on 45 trillion multimodal tokens that developers can download and customize via the company's Tinker platform. The launch positions the startup as a challenger to proprietary frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, betting that organization-specific customization will outperform general-purpose systems.

title: Applied Computing wants to give oil and gas operators an AI model for the entire plant
description: London-based Applied Computing raised a $20 million Series A to build Orbital, a foundation model purpose-built for oil, gas, and petrochemical facilities that combines time-series analysis, physics-based modeling, and language processing to analyze thousands of plant sensors. The company says operators currently use less than 8% of available sensor data, and Orbital aims to compress investigations that took days or weeks into seconds.

title: Indian AI coding startup Emergent becomes a unicorn just over a year after launch
description: Indian AI coding startup Emergent raised a $130 million Series C round that values the company at unicorn status, just over a year after its launch. The rapid rise underscores continued investor appetite for AI coding tools even as competition intensifies among Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Claude Code.
